steps.text: Round 4, S2: a Skip day from the office mid-shift (the clock started on AVAILABLE, a traveller at the desk) lands exactly as a skip of the same day from the briefing: the same day, phase, money, clerkDebtPaid, statement rows and save (but what presenting a traveller may mark: a premade met, a returner, the guide). The skipped day is closed once, by the route: until the landing day's own report the only day end handled is the landing day's. Round 5, S3: a second Skip day asked for under the shutter (the first one's office still loaded) lands exactly as one asked for after the shutter lifted, day 1's ledger never closed again on day 2 (the saves compared also without the News site's back issues: day 2's office never opens in the double skip). Four fresh runs of the golden seed; flowSettled waits for the shutter after each reloading step (S3)
Round 5, S3, the record to compare with: one traveller decided on day 1, Skip day, the shutter off (day 2's office at its briefing), Skip day

Round 5, S3, the double skip: the same, but the second Skip day five frames after the first (the cheat step's own wait), while day 1's office is still loaded under the shutter, with no flowSettled between. It must close day 2 on an empty ledger, as from day 2's briefing, never day 1's ledger again, and no office handles a day end of its own
